trans-unit.source: Created the open-source project Thiis, aiming to provide a package for vanilla JavaScript enabling easy and understandable data validation.
trans-unit.target: Created the open-source project Thiis, aiming to provide a package for vanilla JavaScript enabling easy and understandable data validation.

trans-unit.source: Motivation: Need for precise and unambiguous data validation to avoid misinterpretation by both the system and developers, creating clear and simple validation code.
trans-unit.target: Motivation: Need for precise and unambiguous data validation to avoid misinterpretation by both the system and developers, creating clear and simple validation code.

trans-unit.source: Functionalities:
trans-unit.target: Functionalities:

trans-unit.source: Adding typing for better TypeScript support.
trans-unit.target: Adding typing for better TypeScript support.

trans-unit.source: Introducing simple validation syntax, e.g., is.object(variable) instead of complex conditions.
trans-unit.target: Introducing simple validation syntax, e.g., is.object(variable) instead of complex conditions.

trans-unit.source: Combining various validations, e.g., is.object_not_empty(variable).
trans-unit.target: Combining various validations, e.g., is.object_not_empty(variable).

trans-unit.source: Support for global methods, e.g., is.HTMLElement(variable).
trans-unit.target: Support for global methods, e.g., is.HTMLElement(variable).

trans-unit.source: All methods return boolean values, eliminating validation errors.
trans-unit.target: All methods return boolean values, eliminating validation errors.

trans-unit.source: The library's core uses JavaScript proxies for dynamic method calls based on names provided by developers.
trans-unit.target: The library's core uses JavaScript proxies for dynamic method calls based on names provided by developers.

trans-unit.source: Example: Instead of complex code:if(typeof variable === 'object' && variable !== null && !Array.isArray(variable) && Object.keys(variable)?.length) use simpler and more readable: if (is.object_not_empty(variable))
trans-unit.target: Example: Instead of complex code:if(typeof variable === 'object' && variable !== null && !Array.isArray(variable) && Object.keys(variable)?.length) use simpler and more readable: if (is.object_not_empty(variable))
